# netraom-contracts (demo vendored subset)

Copied from the Netraom monorepo for standalone student use. Includes only:

- `models/enums.py`, `models/graph.py`, `models/finding.py`
- JSON schemas: `trust_graph_node.v1`, `trust_graph_edge.v1`, `finding.v1`

See [../README.md](../README.md) for provenance.
